name: Fire
description: Heat, aggression, and direct damage. Fire cards focus on burst attacks, burns, and risky overdrive effects.

name: Water
description: Flow, adaptability, and control. Water cards manipulate tempo, accuracy, and battlefield position.

name: Electric
description: Speed, disruption, and chain reactions. Electric cards excel at quick hits, stuns, and chaining effects.

name: Nature
description: Growth, recovery, and resilience. Nature cards specialize in healing, regeneration, and swarm tactics.

name: Ice
description: Control, slowdown, and precision. Ice cards freeze, slow, or lock down enemy actions and movement.

name: Steel
description: Armor, structure, and reliability. Steel cards provide strong defenses, blocking, and damage reduction.

name: Dark
description: Risk, corruption, and power at a cost. Dark cards trade health or resources for huge but dangerous payoffs.

name: Light
description: Purity, protection, and clarity. Light cards cleanse debuffs, shield allies, and punish corrupted foes.

name: Psychic
description: Mind games, prediction, and control. Psychic cards reveal information and manipulate choices or positions.

name: Tech
description: Gadgets, automation, and precision tools. Tech cards interact with costs, cooldowns, and battlefield objects.

name: Plasma
description: Unstable, high‑energy power. Plasma cards build charge toward explosive, high‑impact attacks.

name: Wind
description: Air, speed, and evasion. Wind cards emphasize dodges, repositioning, and turn order tricks.

name: Earth
description: Stability, pressure, and terrain. Earth cards create walls, hazards, and sustained frontline presence.

name: Poison
description: Venom, decay, and attrition. Poison cards inflict damage over time and weaken enemy defenses.

name: Crystal
description: Focus, amplification, and channeling. Crystal cards boost or redirect elemental damage and effects.

name: Gravity
description: Weight, control, and positioning. Gravity cards pull, push, or pin targets and warp movement.

name: Toxic
description: Corrosive contamination and area denial. Toxic cards flood zones with lasting hazards and stacking debuffs.

name: Solar
description: Radiant, steady power from the sun. Solar cards reward sustained play, shielding allies and boosting light damage.

name: Lunar
description: Rhythmic, phase‑based magic. Lunar cards change strength over time and interact with status and timing.

name: Void
description: Emptiness, disruption, and anti‑energy. Void cards cancel, erase, or invert other elements and effects.
